source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, Item 6.D Employees
source.quote: In 2025, 2024, and 2023, we had 7,287, 7,691, and 9,123 full-time employees on average, respectively.

source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, Note 5 Personnel expenses (€ millions)
source.quote: 5. Personnel expenses 2025 2024 2023 (in € millions, except employee data) Wages and salaries 1,202 1,187 1,558 Social costs and payroll taxes 311 444 254 Contributions to retirement plans 53 52 55 Share-based compensation 248 267 321 Other employee benefits 110 138 157 Total 1,924 2,088 2,345 Average full-time employees 7,287 7,691 9,123

notes: Employees: Spotify reports only an annual average of full-time employees (7,287 in 2025), not a year-end head count, so the average is used. Payroll: Note 5's total personnel expenses (€1,924 million: wages and salaries, social costs and payroll taxes, retirement contributions, €248 million of share-based compensation and other benefits), in billions of EUR. Social costs fell in 2025 largely because they include payroll taxes on share-based awards, which move with the share price.
